definitions.explanation: An open area enclosed by the walls or wings of a building. Found in traditional Japanese homes, schools, temples, and Western-style architecture.

examples.japanese: {中庭|なかにわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: Flowers are blooming in the courtyard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中庭|なかにわ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}→昼ご飯：02950_hirugohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate lunch in the school courtyard.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{日本庭園|にほんていえん}→日本庭園：19199_nihonteien⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中庭|なかにわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{眺|なが}められる→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧。
examples.english: This hotel has a beautiful Japanese garden courtyard that can be viewed from the rooms.

notes:
{中庭|なかにわ} literally means "inner garden" — an outdoor space enclosed within a building or complex.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中庭|なかにわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{面|めん}する→面する：14629_mensuru⟧ (face the courtyard)
- {中庭|なかにわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧ (house with a courtyard)
- {中庭|なかにわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧ (surround a courtyard)

Traditional Japanese houses (⟦{町家|まちや}→町家：22291_machiya⟧) often feature a small {中庭|なかにわ} called {坪庭|つぼにわ}, which brings light and air into the interior.
